auditSummary: Code fixes for relationship previews, a single save-state artwork resolver, resolved-art scrolling, and several continuity assignments are implemented with existing assets. Four genuine coverage gaps remain: ridge-road still falls back to Greyhaven departure art; march-order and road-conversation reconverge from all three Chapter I forks with no branch-neutral King’s Road plate; c4-snow-span and c4-brass-span still show the three-roads junction after the player has already chosen one span, while the storm sibling has a unique on-span plate. Existing images cannot fill those gaps without spoiling the ambush/folded road, leaking a sibling fork, or showing unchosen spans. Archive, healer, broker, shrine, C2 infirmary continuity, and C7 salt/order/duel are solved or documented with existing assets. Do not replace the beta ZIP until these four deliveries are integrated.

requests.sceneSummary: Chapter I fork after take-ridge from choose-road. Authored scene in app/game-data.ts node ridge-road, title The Watching Glass, location Eastwatch Ridge. Exact prose: 'The ridge road climbs above the rain. Greyhaven shrinks behind you while the eastern hills spread out below. The treaty wagon crawls beside a drop steep enough to smash it into firewood.' 'Sunlight flashes from an abandoned shepherd tower ahead. Once, twice, then three times. Not lightning. A signal mirror.' 'Mara reaches for her bow. Thunder answers from the western sky, closer than before.' Choices take-tower, shield-wagons, and false-signal have not happened yet.

requests.generationBrief: Create one cinematic 16:9 landscape dark-fantasy illustration in painterly realism matching Veilfall: The Ember Oath. Scene: Eastwatch Ridge in rain. A high narrow road with a lethal drop on one side; Greyhaven is a distant shrinking mass behind, eastern hills below. The heavy green medieval treaty wagon with a tree-and-roots emblem crawls close to the ledge. An abandoned stone shepherd tower stands ahead; sunlight flashes from a signal mirror on it two or three times—this is a watcher signal, not a lightning strike on the party. Caelan (31, short tousled dark brown hair, short beard, dark steel/leather armor, faded crimson cloak) is on the ridge with the column. Mara (29, athletic, tied dark brown hair, green leather, bow) reaches toward her bow and watches the tower. Thunder can darken the western sky. Composition: landscape 16:9. Keep Caelan, Mara, the wagon, the drop, and the tower readable inside the reader hero crop (desktop 16:7 center crop of 16:9; mobile 4:3 with object-position 57% center—place important faces and the tower in the central band, slightly right of center). No floodwater, no Eastwatch gate, no saboteur, no arrows, no ambush, no impossible sea, no completed tower assault, no extra named characters required, no text/logos/watermarks, no modern objects, no explicit content.
